 Welcome to Solvly. Your privacy is critically important to us.

 1. Information Collection
 Solvly collects mathematical problems you provide through text input or camera-captured images. These images are processed securely using an internal OCR Engine to extract text.

 2. Use of Information
 The extracted text is sent securely to an Advanced AI Model to generate step-by-step solutions. We do not store your images on our servers. Your problem history is saved locally on your device for your convenience.

 3. Third-Party Services
 Our app utilizes industry-standard AI and OCR technologies. By using Solvly, you agree to the underlying terms and privacy standards of these secure processing partners.

 4. Data Security
 We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to outside parties. Your data (history) remains on your physical device unless you clear it.

 5. Accuracy Disclaimer
 While Solvly uses advanced AI, it may occasionally provide incorrect results or methods. Users are encouraged to verify solutions independently. Solvly is an educational tool and should not be used as a primary source for critical calculations or academic testing.

 6. User Responsibilities
 You agree to use Solvly for educational purposes and in accordance with your institution's academic integrity policies.

 7. Contact Us
 If you have questions regarding this policy, you can reach out via the Support section in Settings.

Solvly - Your Personal Math Tutor

 Solvly is an advanced mathematical problem-solving application designed to help students, teachers, and lifelong learners understand complex math with ease.

 OUR MISSION
 Our goal is to make quality math education accessible to everyone. Whether you are stuck on basic algebra or complex calculus, Solvly provides instant, step-by-step explanations to help you learn the "how" and "why" behind every solution.

 KEY FEATURES
 • Scan & Solve: Point your camera at any problem for instant results.
 • AI Explanations: Deep-learning models break down solutions into easy-to-follow steps.
 • Offline Solver: Solve core mathematical problems even without an internet connection.
 • Problem History: Automatically save and review your previous solutions anytime.

 VERSION: 1.0.0 (Stable)

 Thank you for choosing Solvly to be part of your educational journey!
